blocks.text: «Meni chaqirgan» va «men chaqirgan»: ega yoki to'ldiruvchi

92-darsda **who / that / which** ta'rif ichida **ega** edi: the man **who called me** — u meni chaqirdi (→ 92-dars). Endi teskari holat: ot ta'rif ichidagi fe'lning **to'ldiruvchisi**: the man **(who) I called** — men uni chaqirdim. O'zbekchada bu ikki ma'no bitta harf bilan farqlanadi: «**meni** chaqirgan odam» va «**men** chaqirgan odam». Inglizchada esa farqni **so'z tartibi** ko'rsatadi: who dan keyin darhol **fe'l** kelsa — who ega; who dan keyin **ega** (I, we, my boss) kelsa — who to'ldiruvchi. Ikkinchi holatda **who / that / which tushib qolishi mumkin**, va so'zlashuvda odatda tushib qoladi: the man **I called**. Asoslar qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 102-dars).
Qachon who / that / which tushib qoladi

Sinov oddiy — who / that / which dan keyingi so'zga qarang. **Fe'l** bo'lsa (who **called**, that **won**) — tashlab bo'lmaydi: «the man called me» butunlay boshqa gap bo'lib qoladi. **Ot yoki olmosh** bo'lsa (who **I** called, that **my sister** bought) — tashlash mumkin. Yozma va rasmiy matnda ko'pincha qoldiriladi, so'zlashuvda esa deyarli har doim tushadi. Rasmiy uslubda odam-to'ldiruvchi uchun **whom** ham ishlatiladi: the candidate **whom** we interviewed (→ 94-dars).

items.text: The singer **who won** the contest is from Bukhara.
The singer **we saw** last night is from Bukhara.
Have you read the article **(that) I sent** you?

blocks.text: Predlog gap oxirida: the job I applied for

Ko'p fe'l va sifatlar predlog bilan ishlatiladi: apply **for**, talk **to**, look **for**, wait **for**, work **for / with**, depend **on**, stay **at**, live **in**, be interested **in**, be proud **of**, be afraid **of**, be married **to**. Ta'rif ichida predlog fe'l yoki sifatdan **keyin**, ya'ni ko'pincha gap **oxirida** qoladi: I applied **for** a job → the job I applied **for**. O'zbekchada esa kelishik qo'shimchasi sifatdoshda yo'qoladi: «ish**ga** ariza berdim» → «ariza bergan ishim» — `-ga` yo'q. Shuning uchun o'zbeklar predlogni ko'pincha unutadi. Rasmiy uslubda predlog oldinga o'tishi mumkin: the job **for which** I applied, the people **with whom** I work (→ 96-dars). Lekin predlogni ikki marta yozmang: «the house in which I live **in**» — xato.

items.text: Where's the folder **I was looking for**?
The flat **we're living in** belongs to my uncle.
Is that the colleague **you work with**?

blocks.text: **that** (va which) oldida doim **ot** turadi: the book **that** ... **what** esa otning o'zini ichiga olgan: **what** = **the thing(s) that** — «...gan narsa». **What** you said was true = **The thing that** you said was true. O'zbekchadagi otlashgan sifatdosh — «**aytganing**», «**ko'rganim**», «**kerak narsa**» — ko'pincha aynan **what** ga to'g'ri keladi. Lekin **everything, something, anything, nothing, all, the only** va orttirma darajadan keyin **what emas, that** keladi (yoki hech narsa): **everything (that)** you said — «everything what you said» xato. Bu so'zlardan keyin that to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, odatda tushib qoladi: the best film **I've ever seen**.

rows: **What** he told me was a secret.
The story **(that)** he told me was a secret.

items.text: **What** I like about Edinburgh is the architecture.
Thanks for **everything** you've done for us.
items.translation: Biz uchun **qilgan barcha ishlaringiz** uchun rahmat.

items.text: This is **the only** photo **I have** of my grandfather.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the book I read **it**» → the book I read (ot allaqachon aytilgan, **it** ortiqcha); «the people we met **them**» → the people we met; «the hotel we stayed» → the hotel we stayed **at** (predlog unutiladi); «the man called me» («meni chaqirgan odam» ma'nosida) → the man **who** called me (ega bo'lsa who tushmaydi); «everything **what** you said» → everything (**that**) you said; «the film **what** we saw» → the film (**that**) we saw.

O'zbekcha birikmada sifatdosh oldidan **ega** bor-yo'qligini tekshiring: «**men** chaqirgan», «**Aziz** sotib olgan», «**biz** yashaydigan» — ega bor, demak inglizchada who / that ni tashlab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri otdan keyin ega qo'yasiz: the car **Aziz bought**. Keyin fe'l predlog talab qiladimi (live **in**, wait **for**) — tekshirib, uni oxiriga qo'ying.

examples.title: Subject or object? who **called me** / **I called**
examples.description: who / that dan keyin fe'l kelsa — u ega (tashlab bo'lmaydi). Ega (I, we, Aziz) kelsa — u to'ldiruvchi (tashlash mumkin). O'zbekchada farq «meni» / «men» da ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: The journalist **who interviewed** me was very friendly.
sentences.translation: **Men bilan suhbat o'tkazgan** jurnalist juda samimiy edi.

sentences.text: Madina says the chef **she interviewed** for the article was rude.
sentences.translation: Madinaning aytishicha, maqola uchun **u suhbat olgan** oshpaz qo'pol ekan.

sentences.text: Is that the dog **that bit** your brother?
sentences.translation: Akangni **tishlagan** it shumi?

sentences.text: Is that the dog **you rescued** from the river?
sentences.translation: **Sen** daryodan **qutqargan** it shumi?

sentences.text: Bekzod is the colleague **who recommended** me for this job.
sentences.translation: Bekzod — **meni** bu ishga **tavsiya qilgan** hamkasbim.

sentences.text: Bekzod is also the colleague **I recommended** for promotion.
sentences.translation: Bekzod — **men** lavozimga **tavsiya qilgan** hamkasb ham.

sentences.text: Students **who failed** the test will take it again next week.
sentences.translation: Testdan **o'ta olmagan** talabalar uni kelasi hafta qayta topshiradi.

sentences.text: All the students **the teacher praised** had worked very hard.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **maqtagan** talabalarning hammasi juda qattiq mehnat qilgan edi.

sentences.text: I'm looking for the man **who found** my wallet so that I can thank him.
sentences.translation: Hamyonimni **topib olgan** odamni qidiryapman — unga rahmat aytmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the wallet **I found** in the park had no ID in it, so I took it to the police.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bog'da **men topib olgan** hamyonda hech qanday hujjat yo'q edi, shuning uchun uni politsiyaga topshirdim.

examples.title: Leaving out **who** / **that**: the people **we met**
examples.description: who / that to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, so'zlashuvda odatda tushib qoladi: the people (who) we met. Ta'rifning o'z egasi bor: we, I, Kate, they.

sentences.text: The people **we met** in Bukhara invited us to their daughter's wedding.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **biz tanishgan** odamlar bizni qizlarining to'yiga taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: Is this the girl **your brother is going to marry**?
sentences.translation: Akangiz **uylanmoqchi bo'lgan** qiz shumi?

sentences.text: The man **Kate married** is twenty years older than her.
sentences.translation: Keyt **turmushga chiqqan** erkak undan yigirma yosh katta.

sentences.text: Most of the friends **I made** at university now live abroad.
sentences.translation: Universitetda **orttirgan** do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi hozir chet elda yashaydi.

sentences.text: The new manager **they hired** has already made some big changes.
sentences.translation: Ular **ishga olgan** yangi menejer allaqachon katta o'zgarishlar qildi.

sentences.text: Did you like the guests **I invited**? — Yes, they were great fun.
sentences.translation: **Men taklif qilgan** mehmonlar sizga yoqdimi? — Ha, juda quvnoq ekan.

sentences.text: Dilnoza still writes to a teacher **she had** at primary school.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza boshlang'ich maktabda unga **dars bergan** o'qituvchiga hali ham xat yozib turadi.

sentences.text: At the clinic, the doctor **we saw** told us not to worry.
sentences.translation: Klinikada **biz uchrashgan** shifokor xavotir olmaslikni aytdi.

sentences.text: James is the only colleague **I trust** completely.
sentences.translation: Jeyms — **men** butunlay **ishonadigan** yagona hamkasb.

sentences.text: Several of the candidates **the committee interviewed** had no real experience.
sentences.translation: Komissiya **suhbat o'tkazgan** nomzodlarning bir nechtasida haqiqiy tajriba yo'q edi.

examples.title: Things: the film **we watched**, the app **I use**
examples.description: Narsa haqida ham: that / which to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, tushib qolishi mumkin — the book (that) I'm reading. Olmosh (it, them) qo'shilmaydi!

sentences.text: The film **we watched** last night was based on a true story.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **biz ko'rgan** film haqiqiy voqea asosida olingan.

sentences.text: Can I borrow the book **you finished** yesterday?
sentences.translation: Kecha **o'qib tugatgan** kitobingni olib tursam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: This is the app **I use** to learn new words every day.
sentences.translation: Bu — har kuni yangi so'zlar o'rganish uchun **foydalanadigan** ilovam.

sentences.text: The soup **Madina made** for us was absolutely delicious.
sentences.translation: Madina bizga **pishirgan** sho'rva juda mazali edi.

sentences.text: Where are the photos **you took** at the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'yda **olgan** suratlaring qani?

sentences.text: Most of the emails **I get** at work are completely useless.
sentences.translation: Ishda **oladigan** xatlarimning ko'pchiligi mutlaqo foydasiz.

sentences.text: The car **Aziz bought** last year has already broken down twice.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'tgan yili **sotib olgan** mashina allaqachon ikki marta buzildi.

sentences.text: I've lost the umbrella **my sister gave** me for my birthday.
sentences.translation: Opam tug'ilgan kunimga **sovg'a qilgan** soyabonni yo'qotib qo'ydim.

sentences.text: Did you finish the report **the boss wanted** by Friday?
sentences.translation: Boshliq jumagacha **so'ragan** hisobotni tugatdingizmi?

sentences.text: Prices went up after the decision **the bank made** last spring.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahorda bank **qabul qilgan** qarordan keyin narxlar oshib ketdi.

examples.title: Preposition at the end: the job **I applied for**
examples.description: Fe'l + predlog (apply for, talk to, look for, work for, wait for) ta'rif ichida bo'lsa, predlog fe'ldan keyin — ko'pincha gap oxirida qoladi. O'zbekchada esa kelishik qo'shimchasi sifatdoshda yo'qoladi.

sentences.text: Did you get the job **you applied for**?
sentences.translation: **Ariza topshirgan** ishingizga qabul qilindingizmi?

sentences.text: The hotel **we stayed at** in Edinburgh was right next to the castle.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **biz to'xtagan** mehmonxona qal'aning yonginasida edi.

sentences.text: Who's the man **you were talking to** at the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda **gaplashib turgan** odaming kim?

sentences.text: This is the key **I was looking for** all morning!
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri **qidirgan** kalitim mana shu!

sentences.text: The company **Bekzod works for** has offices in Seoul and London.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **ishlaydigan** kompaniyaning Seul va Londonda ofislari bor.

sentences.text: Is this the bus **we're waiting for**, or is it the next one?
sentences.translation: Biz **kutayotgan** avtobus shumi yoki keyingisimi?

sentences.text: Success often depends on the people **you work with**.
sentences.translation: Muvaffaqiyat ko'pincha **birga ishlaydigan** odamlaringizga bog'liq.

sentences.text: The music **Oliver listens to** is far too loud for me.
sentences.translation: Oliver **tinglaydigan** musiqa men uchun juda baland.

sentences.text: Nilufar finally found the flat **she'd dreamed of** for years.
sentences.translation: Nilufar nihoyat yillar davomida **orzu qilgan** kvartirasini topdi.

sentences.text: To be honest, the problem **I'm worried about** isn't the price but the delivery time.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, **meni xavotirga solayotgan** muammo narx emas, yetkazib berish muddati.

examples.title: Adjective + preposition: the man **she's married to**
examples.description: Sifat + predlog (proud of, afraid of, interested in, good at, married to, responsible for) ham gap oxirida qoladi. Rasmiy uslubda predlog oldinga o'tadi: the colleagues with whom I work.

sentences.text: The man **Sarah is married to** is a well-known surgeon.
sentences.translation: Sara **turmush qurgan** erkak taniqli jarroh.

sentences.text: Swimming is the only sport **I've ever been good at**.
sentences.translation: Suzish — **qo'limdan keladigan** yagona sport turi.

sentences.text: Genetics is the subject **Madina is most interested in**.
sentences.translation: Genetika — Madinani **eng ko'p qiziqtiradigan** fan.

sentences.text: Spiders are the only thing **my brother is afraid of**.
sentences.translation: O'rgimchaklar — akam **qo'rqadigan** yagona narsa.

sentences.text: That's the project **I'm responsible for** this year.
sentences.translation: Bu — bu yil men **mas'ul bo'lgan** loyiha.

sentences.text: Traffic is something **everyone complains about** but nobody tries to change.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik — **hamma shikoyat qiladigan**, lekin hech kim o'zgartirishga urinmaydigan narsa.

sentences.text: My grandfather's garden is the thing **he's proudest of**.
sentences.translation: Bog'i — bobomning **eng ko'p faxrlanadigan** narsasi.

sentences.text: Who's the girl **Jasur is in love with**? Is she from his university?
sentences.translation: Jasur **sevib qolgan** qiz kim? U uning universitetidanmi?

sentences.text: The town **I grew up in** has changed a lot since the 1990s.
sentences.translation: Men **o'sgan** shaharcha 1990-yillardan beri ancha o'zgardi.

sentences.text: The colleagues **with whom** I work have always been very supportive.
sentences.translation: **Birga ishlaydigan** hamkasblarim doim meni qo'llab-quvvatlab kelgan.

examples.title: **everything** / **the only** / **the best** + (that)
examples.description: everything, something, nothing, anything, all, the only, the first / last va orttirma darajadan keyin that keladi (what emas) va to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa ko'pincha tushib qoladi.

sentences.text: **Everything** you told me about the course was true.
sentences.translation: Kurs haqida menga **aytganlaringizning hammasi** to'g'ri chiqdi.

sentences.text: Is there **anything** I can do to help with the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'y tayyorgarligida **qo'limdan keladigan biror ish** bormi?

sentences.text: That's **the best** meal **I've ever eaten** in a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Bu — restoranda **yegan** eng mazali taomim.

sentences.text: **The only** thing **I remember** about the accident is a loud bang.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan **yodimda qolgan yagona narsa** — kuchli gumburlash.

sentences.text: There's **nothing** you can say that will change my mind.
sentences.translation: Siz **aytadigan hech bir gap** fikrimni o'zgartira olmaydi.

sentences.text: **The first** thing Emma does every morning is check her phone.
sentences.translation: Emmaning har kuni ertalab **qiladigan birinchi ishi** — telefonini tekshirish.

sentences.text: Is this **all** you've done today? — Sorry, I had lots of meetings.
sentences.translation: Bugun **qilgan ishingiz shumi**? — Kechirasiz, majlislar ko'p edi.

sentences.text: Of all the places in Asia, Khiva is **the most magical** town **I've ever stayed in**.
sentences.translation: Osiyodagi barcha joylar ichida Xiva — men **tunab qolgan** eng sehrli shahar.

sentences.text: **Something** you said yesterday made me think about my career.
sentences.translation: Kecha **aytgan bir gapingiz** meni kasbim haqida o'ylashga majbur qildi.

sentences.text: He was **the last** person **I expected** to see at the gym!
sentences.translation: Uni sport zalida ko'raman deb **umuman kutmagandim**!

examples.title: **what** = the thing(s) that
examples.description: what — «...gan narsa» (ot ichida): What you need is rest = The thing that you need. O'zbekchadagi otlashgan sifatdosh («aytganing», «ko'rganim») ko'pincha what ga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: **What** you said at the meeting really upset Jasur.
sentences.translation: Majlisda **aytganingiz** Jasurni qattiq xafa qildi.

sentences.text: I didn't understand **what** the doctor was explaining.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **tushuntirayotgan narsani** tushunmadim.

sentences.text: **What** I need right now is a long holiday by the sea.
sentences.translation: Menga hozir **kerak narsa** — dengiz bo'yida uzoq dam olish.

sentences.text: Did you see **what** happened at the crossroads this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab chorrahada **nima bo'lganini** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: Tell me **what** you want for your birthday, and I'll buy it.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningga **nima xohlayotganingni** ayt, sotib olaman.

sentences.text: Kate always does **what** she thinks is right, even if it's unpopular.
sentences.translation: Keyt hatto ko'pchilikka yoqmasa ham, har doim o'zi to'g'ri deb **bilgan ishini** qiladi.

sentences.text: **What** surprised me most about London was how green it is.
sentences.translation: Londonda meni **eng ko'p hayratga solgan narsa** — uning qanchalik yashilligi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The guide showed us **what** was left of the ancient fortress.
sentences.translation: Gid bizga qadimiy qal'adan **qolgan narsalarni** ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: Sorry, that's not **what** I ordered — I asked for chicken, not beef.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu men **buyurtma qilgan narsa** emas — mol go'shti emas, tovuq so'ragandim.

sentences.text: We can't always get **what** we want, but we can try.
sentences.translation: Har doim **xohlaganimizga** erisha olmaymiz, lekin urinib ko'rishimiz mumkin.

examples.title: Mixed: **what** or **that**? With or without **who**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ega va to'ldiruvchi, who / that ning tushishi, predlog oxirida, what va that farqi.

sentences.text: Thank you for **everything** you've done — it's exactly **what** we needed.
sentences.translation: **Qilgan barcha ishlaringiz** uchun rahmat — bu aynan bizga **kerak narsa** edi.

sentences.text: The course **I signed up for** was much harder than I expected.
sentences.translation: **Men yozilgan** kurs men kutgandan ancha qiyin bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Most of **what** you read on social media isn't checked by anyone.
sentences.translation: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda **o'qiganlaringizning** ko'pini hech kim tekshirmaydi.

sentences.text: The man **who repaired** our roof is the same man **we hired** last year.
sentences.translation: Tomimizni **tuzatgan** usta — biz o'tgan yili **yollagan** odamning o'zi.

sentences.text: Is this the report **you were complaining about**? It looks fine to me.
sentences.translation: Siz **shikoyat qilayotgan** hisobot shumi? Menimcha, yaxshi-ku.

sentences.text: Aziz showed me the photos **he took** in Khiva, and **what** I loved most was the sunset.
sentences.translation: Aziz menga Xivada **olgan** suratlarini ko'rsatdi, menga **eng ko'p yoqqani** — quyosh botishi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The only person **who knows** the code is the manager, and she's on holiday.
sentences.translation: Kodni **biladigan** yagona odam — menejer, u esa ta'tilda.

sentences.text: Nothing **we tried** worked, so we called an electrician.
sentences.translation: **Sinab ko'rgan** hech bir usulimiz ish bermadi, shuning uchun elektrik chaqirdik.

sentences.text: Is **what** they're saying about the new boss true?
sentences.translation: Yangi boshliq haqida **aytishayotgan gaplar** rostmi?

sentences.text: This year the students **I teach** are much more motivated than the ones **I had** before.
sentences.translation: Bu yil **men dars beradigan** talabalar avvalgi **o'quvchilarimga** qaraganda ancha intiluvchan.
